_why: Store screen never opens because CGameRemoteObjectArray::Add returns FALSE on its Find: the (m_idLocalPlayer=1, localObjectID) entry already exists when ChangeControlOnLoadGame tries to claim, so pObject->m_remotePlayerID stays 0 and CScreenWorld::StartStore sees bInControl=0. Add/ChangeControl/CGameObjectArray::Add are all verified faithful against the asm, so the only hypothesis left is INITIALISATION ORDER: in the original m_idLocalPlayer may still be 0 while the party objects are added during load, making the two Add calls collide on (0, index) and leaving the later claim free to succeed. Ours already holds 1 at that point. This table logs m_idLocalPlayer at every site that touches the chain, on the original, so the ordering is measured rather than argued.
_globals: g_pChitin = 0x8CF6D8 (distinct from g_pBaldurChitin 0x8CF6DC). CNetwork sits at CChitin+0x952, so m_bIsHost(06E1)=+0x1033, m_bPlayerCreated(06F9)=+0x104B, m_idLocalPlayer(06FA)=+0x104C. Confirmed against the asm at 0x59A3FA-0x59A415 and 0x59BF33.
